style.title: التراكب
style.description: اختر تراكب التسجيل: «بلا» يخفيه، و«مبسط» يعرض شارة صغيرة، و«مباشر» يعرض النص المكتوب فوريًا أثناء التحدث (النماذج التي تدعم البث فقط — ابحث عن شارة «البث» في منتقي النماذج). على Linux يُنصح باختيار «بلا».

position.title: موقع التراكب

typingTool.title: أداة الكتابة
typingTool.description: .اختر أداة الكتابة في Linux لاستخدامها مع طريقة اللصق المباشر. سيكتشف "تلقائي" تلقائياً أفضل أداة متاحة لنظامك ويستخدمها

customWords.title: Manage Hotwords
customWords.description: For hotwords starting with English letters, enter exactly the first three letters. For hotwords starting with Chinese characters, enter the full pinyin or Natural Code double-pinyin code of the first two characters. The full hotword appears first at that prefix; continuing to type removes the prefix completion. Speech recognition uses hotwords as preferred references; results still depend on context, pronunciation, and the model.

voiceActivityDetection.title: كشف النشاط الصوتي
voiceActivityDetection.description: تصفية الصمت من التسجيلات. النماذج التي تدعم البث تستخدم فترة VAD أطول؛ وتعطيل VAD يسجّل الصوت الخام.

holdThreshold.description: في الوضع التلقائي فقط: المدة (بالمللي ثانية) التي يجب الاستمرار في الضغط على الاختصار خلالها ليُعدّ ضغطًا مطوّلًا بدلًا من نقرة. قلّلها إذا ظلّ التسجيل مستمرًا بعد ضغطات مطوّلة قصيرة؛ وزدها إذا عُوملت النقرات المقصودة على أنها ضغط مطوّل.

inputiaPermissionHelp.description: Only the Inputia main app needs Accessibility access. The input method handles basic typing without a separate grant.
inputiaPermissionHelp.settings: Pause input control and open permissions
inputiaPermissionHelp.note: Maintenance and recovery do not change system grants. If the main app is unavailable, voice and target-verified features pause while basic typing remains available.
inputiaPermissionHelp.missing: The input method for this installation was not found. Install the matching Inputia component first; the daily installation will not be used as a fallback.
inputiaPermissionHelp.failed: Could not open the location. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security manually, or try again.
inputiaPermissionHelp.rechecking: Checking permissions and rebuilding input control. Previous recordings and text are not replayed.
inputiaPermissionHelp.notStopped: Input control has not stopped safely. Permission settings were not opened. Restart the affected component before changing permissions.
inputiaPermissionHelp.pausedNote: Input control is paused. After finishing in System Settings, return here to recheck and restore.

confirmHistoryTerm.title: Confirm a term
confirmHistoryTerm.description: Enter one verified term (2–32 characters), not the full transcript. The source and revision must pass privacy checks.
confirmHistoryTerm.consent: I confirm this term and allow it to be saved to the local dictionary only.
confirmHistoryTerm.saved: Saved to the local dictionary. Shared use by speech recognition and the input method is still being integrated in this candidate.
confirmHistoryTerm.failed: The result is not confirmed. Retrying uses the same operation. Changed, untrusted or sensitive sources cannot be learned.
confirmHistoryTerm.replayed: This confirmation was already processed and will not learn again. Later deletion or forgetting remains in effect.

knowledge.title: Knowledge library
knowledge.description: Search documents, voice transcripts, captured typing snippets and clipboard records together.
knowledge.sourceHelp: Indexing and external AI access are separate permissions. Removing a linked source keeps your original files.
knowledge.removeConfirm: Unlink {{name}}? Original files will remain on disk.
knowledge.empty: No matching knowledge. Add a source or try another search.
knowledge.connectionHelp: Generate a prompt for an AI that can run local commands. It explains how to install the skill and query the sources you allow. Web-only AI cannot directly read this computer. Retrieved text may be sent to the AI provider.
knowledge.managedHelp: Changing the knowledge folder switches the indexed location; existing files are not moved.
knowledge.formats: Supports UTF-8 text files including Markdown, CSV, JSON and YAML, up to 5 MiB each. PDF and Word documents are not supported yet.
knowledge.moreResults: More results are available. Refine your keywords or select a source.
knowledge.partialImport: Some files could not be imported. See the details below.
knowledge.truncated: This preview contains the beginning of a long record. The external query tool can read subsequent pages.
knowledge.typingUnavailable: Verified typing records are not connected yet. Use New note to add content.
knowledge.captureTypingHelp: Captures only text confirmed as committed by Inputia in a verified non-sensitive field, not other input methods or global keystrokes. Turning this off keeps existing records. Search inclusion and external AI access are controlled separately.
knowledge.clearTypingConfirm: Clear all typing records from the knowledge library? These records cannot be restored. Text in the original apps stays unchanged, and future automatic capture remains unchanged.
knowledge.deleteTypingConfirm: Delete the typing record “{{title}}” from the knowledge library? This record cannot be restored. Text in the original app stays unchanged.

personalization.title: Typing habits and suggestions
personalization.description: Inputia learns locally to improve suggestions without a network model, independently of full-text capture and external AI access. Turning this off keeps learned data. This switch does not control Rime’s native user dictionary, which continues learning under its own rules.
personalization.backfillHelp: History is used only when you explicitly select a source and confirm. Existing history stays unchanged.
personalization.confirmBackfill: Use up to {{count}} records from “{{source}}” to learn input habits? Choosing this source authorizes this learning batch only; external AI access remains unchanged.
personalization.confirmForget: Forget Inputia’s personalization contributions for “{{text}}”? Original history and Rime’s native user dictionary stay unchanged.
personalization.confirmClear: Clear all learning contributions in Inputia’s personalization layer? This cannot be undone. Original history and Rime’s native user dictionary stay unchanged.

summaryFields.skipped: Skipped this batch: {{count}} (duplicates, no learnable phrases or capacity limits)

personalization.moreHistory: This source has more records. Continue the next batch explicitly.
personalization.partialTerms: Term and learning-event counts and the term list include only sources verified in this pass, not all imported records. The total import count is shown separately.
